coverage.summary: Repaired candidate example 0 by adding matching visible black labels S, U, V, W, X, Y, Z and T to both diagrams, positioned outside scan boxes and clear of activity edges. Preserved its mathematics and all other example fields; examples 1 and 2 are unchanged. Checked all three examples' calculations, source alignment, gutters and solution annotations. Together they cover the distinct assessed methods. Solution prose and mathematics inherit renderer blue; ordinary diagram labels remain black. No bare opening expression requires a phantom equals gutter. The baseline has zero existing examples. Practice and quiz mathematics were neither changed nor re-audited. No files were written or subagents used. Independent reviewer acceptance and actual final-size visual verification remain pending.

examples.derivation: Independently obtained ESTs S,U,V,W,X,Y,Z,T = 0,6,4,8,8,12,15,17 and LSTs = 0,6,7,8,10,12,15,17. The dummy W→X contributes zero in both scans. Completion time is 17 minutes; EST(G)=12 minutes; LST(F)=12−2=10 minutes. Both diagrams have matching topology, durations and vertex labels.
Only P arrives at V, so p=5+7=12. Only P leaves U, so q=14−7=7. Both vertices satisfy EST≤LST. The solution diagram preserves the givens and adds the correct values.

The known arriving total is 8+3=11. Since the merge EST is 14, 4+x=14 and x=10 days. Forward values are 0,4,8,14,19; backward values are 0,4,11,14,19. These agree with every supplied box and the annotated solution diagram.
